reviewMethod: Antigravity drafts separately reviewed against complete archived version bodies and source notes; source discrepancies retained explicitly.

headings.title: Department operating name and administrative authority
headings.reviewNote: Specifies department operation as Department of Commerce and Insurance and administration under reorganization act and executive order.

headings.title: Definitions of department and director
headings.reviewNote: Defines department and director as used within this chapter.

headings.title: Construction of statutory and regulatory department references
headings.reviewNote: Deems statutory and regulatory references to department of insurance to refer to constitutional department and chapter.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified all 3 subsections and history note against archived text; confirmed Department of Commerce and Insurance operating name, chapter definitions, and statutory reference construction.

headings.title: Revisor duty to update department name references
headings.reviewNote: Directs revisor of statutes to update statutory department references to department of insurance, financial institutions and professional registration.

headings.title: Revisor duty to update director title references
headings.reviewNote: Directs revisor of statutes to update statutory references to director of the department of insurance, financial institutions and professional registration.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified both subsections and history note against archived text; confirmed revisor directives to update department and director statutory references.

headings.title: Definition of insurer for bulletin provisions
headings.reviewNote: Defines insurer broadly for bulletin provisions to include entities engaged in insurance business and specified chapters.

headings.title: Definition of bulletin
headings.reviewNote: Defines bulletin as an informational written communication to educate industry and public without evaluating specific facts.

headings.title: Discretionary issuance of bulletins by director
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes director to issue bulletins addressing the business of insurance at director's discretion.

headings.title: Legal status and non-rulemaking effect of bulletins
headings.reviewNote: Provides that bulletins lack force of law and do not require formal rule promulgation.

headings.title: Nonbinding effect, revision, and withdrawal of bulletins
headings.reviewNote: Specifies bulletins are nonbinding, revisions or withdrawals are prospective, and sets ninety-day effective date.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified all 5 subsections and history note against archived text; noted catchline typo ("bulleting") vs body ("bulletins") and confirmed nonbinding status and 90-day prospective revision/withdrawal.

headings.title: Definition of no-action letter
headings.reviewNote: Defines no-action letter as department statement of intent not to take enforcement actions under section 374.046 based on presented facts.

headings.title: Definition of insurer for no-action letters
headings.reviewNote: Defines insurer under no-action letter provisions by reference to chapter 354, 376, 379, or 380; retains original-rolls footnote (*Word "chapters" appears in original rolls).

headings.title: Discretionary authority of director to issue no-action letters
headings.reviewNote: Permits director at discretion to issue no-action letters addressing business of insurance.

headings.title: Non-rulemaking status of no-action letters
headings.reviewNote: Provides no-action letters are not statements of general applicability requiring rulemaking.

headings.title: Submission of written request for no-action letter
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes insurers seeking guidance to submit written requests for no-action letters to the department.

headings.title: Disclosure obligations and documentation required from applicant
headings.reviewNote: Imposes affirmative obligation for full disclosure and complete documentation with no-action requests.

headings.title: Duty to provide additional information upon department request
headings.reviewNote: Requires requesting insurer to supply additional information or documents requested by the department.

headings.title: Withdrawal of no-action letter request
headings.reviewNote: Allows insurer to withdraw no-action letter request prior to issuance.

headings.title: Timeframe for department action on no-action request
headings.reviewNote: Directs department to act on request within ninety days of receiving all necessary review information.

headings.title: Department options upon completion of review
headings.reviewNote: Outlines options upon review completion to issue, decline, or take other appropriate action.

headings.title: Effective date of issued no-action letter
headings.reviewNote: Specifies no-action letter is effective as of the date of issuance.

headings.title: Estoppel effect and financial condition exception
headings.reviewNote: Estops department enforcement absent material changes or misrepresentations, excluding financial condition actions.

headings.title: Public record status and trade secret protection
headings.reviewNote: Specifies public record timing upon response and protects proprietary or trade secret materials under chapter 417.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified all 13 subsections, history note, and original-rolls footnote (*Word "chapters" appears in original rolls) in subsection (2); confirmed subsection (12) estoppel exception for financial condition and subsection (13) public-record/trade-secret rules.

headings.title: Appointment, qualifications, and term of director
headings.reviewNote: Designates chief officer as director appointed by governor with senate consent, serving concurrently with governor.

headings.title: Filling of vacancy in office of director
headings.reviewNote: Requires governor to fill director vacancies by appointment subject to senate confirmation.

headings.title: Prohibition on holding positions in regulated insurance entities
headings.reviewNote: Bars director and deputy from holding officer, agent, or employee positions in insurance companies or agencies.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified all 3 subsections and history/prior revision notes against archived text; confirmed director appointment, vacancy confirmation, and conflict-of-interest prohibition.

headings.title: General duties of director, certificates, and record delivery
headings.reviewNote: Outlines duties to maintain filings, issue certificates of authority, protect public interest, and transfer records to successor.

headings.title: Licensing and certificate actions governed by insurance laws
headings.reviewNote: Provides that company licensing and certificate proceedings follow insurance laws notwithstanding chapter 621 provisions.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified both subsections, § 375.920 cross-reference, and 1974 Survivor's Benefit Insurance Co. v. Farmer annotation; confirmed general duties and insurance-law precedence over §§ 621.015–621.198.

headings.title: Rulemaking authority of director
headings.reviewNote: Grants director rulemaking authority regarding internal affairs, department proceedings, and statutory interpretation.

headings.title: Withdrawal or amendment of rules by director
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes director to withdraw or amend rules from time to time under applicable insurance laws.

headings.title: Statutory compliance and rulemaking effectiveness
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits conflicting rules and requires promulgation pursuant to section 536.024 for effectiveness.

headings.title: Notice and hearing requirements for proposed rules
headings.reviewNote: Requires at least fifteen days' advance notice and hearing for interpretive rules, with mailing to registered persons.

headings.title: Penalties for willful violation of department rules
headings.reviewNote: Subjects willful rule violations to statutory penalties applicable to underlying insurance laws.

headings.title: Availability and cost of rules and orders upon request
headings.reviewNote: Requires director to furnish copies of rules, regulations, or orders upon request and payment of reasonable costs.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified all 6 subsections and history note against archived text; confirmed rulemaking scope, § 536.024 effectiveness, 15-day interpretive rule hearing notice, willful violation penalties, and copy fees.

headings.title: Administrative enforcement orders and relief authorized
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes director to issue cease and desist orders, curative orders, civil penalties, and investigative costs.

headings.title: Factors considered in determining administrative relief
headings.reviewNote: Requires director to consider recurrence risk, consumer restitution, self-audit reporting, and prior compliance policies.

headings.title: Notice of intent, statement of reasons, and hearing schedule
headings.reviewNote: Requires written statement of reasons and show-cause notice at least ten days prior to hearing unless summary order applies.

headings.title: Summary cease and desist orders for specified violations
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes immediate summary cease and desist orders where sections 375.014, 375.144, or 375.310 are violated.

headings.title: Summary order contents, hearing requests, and finality
headings.reviewNote: Requires summary order to state reasons, hearing procedures within thirty days, and potential penalties or costs.

headings.title: Hearing procedures and required findings for final order
headings.reviewNote: Requires hearing before director or designated officer and written findings of fact and conclusions of law.

headings.title: Imposition of civil penalties and forfeitures in final orders
headings.reviewNote: Permits civil penalty or forfeiture under section 374.049 only if person engaged in the violative conduct.

headings.title: Assessment of investigative costs to insurance dedicated fund
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes director to charge actual costs of investigation or proceeding to credit of insurance dedicated fund.

headings.title: Subpoena powers and witness examination in proceedings
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes director to issue subpoenas, compel attendance, administer oaths, and require document production.

headings.title: Service methods and proof for administrative process
headings.reviewNote: Specifies service of notices, orders, and charges personally or by certified mail, with return receipt proving service.

headings.title: Filing and enforcement of unappealed final order as judgment
headings.reviewNote: Allows unappealed final orders to be filed with court clerk to have same effect as court judgment.

headings.title: Judicial enforcement, civil contempt, and violation penalties
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes court petition to enforce orders, civil contempt findings, level three violation status, and contempt penalties.

headings.title: Director authority to modify or set aside order prior to review
headings.reviewNote: Allows director to modify or vacate orders before expiration of review period or transcript filing in Cole County.

headings.title: Cumulative nature of statutory enforcement powers
headings.reviewNote: Specifies enforcement authority under section is cumulative to any other statutory powers.

headings.title: Administrative consent orders and settlement agreements
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes consent orders in public interest resolving proceedings through restitution, penalties, and remedial terms.

headings.title: Criminal penalties and license revocation for willful violations
headings.reviewNote: Establishes criminal fines and imprisonment up to ten years, plus license revocation, for willful violation of final orders.

headings.title: Definition of person for chapter provisions
headings.reviewNote: Defines person to include individuals, partnerships, corporations, associations, trusts, and other legal entities.

headings.title: Definition of order and excluded department communications
headings.reviewNote: Defines order as formal administrative direction, expressly excluding bulletins, no-action letters, and advisory opinions.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified all 18 subsections and 1984 American Family Life v. Teasdale annotation against archived text; confirmed subsection (4) summary cease-and-desist authority, consent orders, civil contempt, and criminal penalties.

headings.title: Suspension or revocation of certificate of authority
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes director after hearing to suspend or revoke certificate of authority for willful level 3–5 violations or felony/misdemeanor conviction.

headings.title: Thirty-day advance notice, hearing, and chapter 536 findings
headings.reviewNote: Requires at least 30 days advance notice with statement of reasons, written hearing request, and chapter 536 findings of fact and conclusions of law.

headings.title: Cumulative nature of enforcement authority
headings.reviewNote: Specifies director enforcement authority under this section is cumulative to any other statutory authority.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified all 3 subsections and history note against archived text; replaced all 3 mismatched draft titles/notes to match certificate-of-authority suspension/revocation, 30-day notice/chapter 536 hearing, and cumulative enforcement authority.

headings.title: Civil actions to enjoin violations and enforce compliance
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes director to maintain circuit court actions to enjoin violations and enforce insurance laws or orders.

headings.title: Judicial remedies, asset freezes, and restitution awards
headings.reviewNote: Details available relief including injunctions, receivers, civil penalties, consumer restitution, interest, and costs.

headings.title: Exemption of director from court bond requirement
headings.reviewNote: Exempts director from posting bond in civil enforcement actions.

headings.title: Venue for civil enforcement proceedings
headings.reviewNote: Establishes venue in Cole County, the county of violation, or where defendant is otherwise subject to venue.

headings.title: Cumulative nature of judicial enforcement authority
headings.reviewNote: Provides that judicial enforcement powers under section are cumulative to other statutory remedies.

headings.title: Authority to enter into consent injunctions and settlements
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes director to enter into consent injunctions and settlement judgments in the public interest.

headings.title: Consumer Restitution Fund creation, distribution, and transfers
headings.reviewNote: Creates Consumer Restitution Fund for disgorgement distribution, barring general revenue lapse and funding consumer education.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified all 7 subsections and history note against archived text; confirmed circuit court injunctions, ancillary remedies, bond exemption, venue, consent judgments, and Consumer Restitution Fund.

headings.title: Establishment of five-tier violation classification system
headings.reviewNote: Establishes five-tier violation system from level one to level five for civil penalties and forfeitures.

headings.title: Administrative civil penalty maximums by violation tier
headings.reviewNote: Sets administrative civil penalty caps under section 374.046 from $0 (level 1) up to $50,000 per violation / $250,000 annual aggregate (level 5).

headings.title: Judicial civil penalty maximums by violation tier
headings.reviewNote: Sets court-imposed civil penalty caps under section 374.048 from $0 (level 1) up to $1,000,000 per level 5 violation with no aggregate limit.

headings.title: Prerequisite of direct engagement in violative conduct
headings.reviewNote: Bars civil penalty or forfeiture unless person engaged in the act, practice, omission, or course of business.

headings.title: Default level one classification for unclassified violations
headings.reviewNote: Classifies non-statutorily categorized violations and standalone rule violations as level one without enhancement.

headings.title: Discretionary consideration of circumstances in penalty setting
headings.reviewNote: Directs court or director to consider circumstances and violation nature within statutory maximum range.

headings.title: Step increases for knowing violations and conscious disregard
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes one-level increase for knowing violations and two-level increase for conscious disregard of the law.

headings.title: Step increase for violations causing consumer financial loss
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes one-step increase where violations resulted in actual financial loss to consumers.

headings.title: Step reduction for self-audit detection and prompt reporting
headings.reviewNote: Mandates up to two-step penalty reduction when violations are detected via self-audit and promptly reported.

headings.title: Single violation treatment for data processing errors
headings.reviewNote: Treats multiple errors from single data processing act as single violation if unknown at time of occurrence.

headings.title: Payment of recovered penalties to school fund
headings.reviewNote: Directs recovered penalties and forfeitures to state treasurer for distribution to public schools under Mo. Const. Art. IX Sec. 7.

headings.title: Prospective applicability to conduct after August 28, 2006
headings.reviewNote: Specifies penalty provisions apply only to proceedings instituted on conduct occurring after August 28, 2006.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified all 12 subsections and history note against archived text; corrected subsection (2) title/note (administrative § 374.046 caps) and clarified subsection (3) (judicial § 374.048 caps), five-tier matrix, self-audit reduction, and post-Aug 28, 2006 scope.

headings.title: Official seal of office of director
headings.reviewNote: Establishes existing department seal as official seal of director and permits renewal when necessary.

headings.title: Evidentiary effect of certified and sealed records
headings.reviewNote: Provides certified and sealed copies from director have equal evidentiary force and effect as original papers.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified both subsections and history/prior revision notes against archived text; confirmed official seal and equal evidentiary force of certified sealed copies.

headings.title: Petition to administrative hearing commission upon license refusal
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes license applicants refused under section 375.141 to petition commission, retaining director discretion.

headings.title: Disciplinary proceedings before administrative hearing commission
headings.reviewNote: Requires director to refer license revocation or suspension to commission, maintaining director authority on discipline.

headings.title: Procedural laws governing hearings and judicial review
headings.reviewNote: Specifies chapters 536 and 621 govern administrative hearings and judicial review of decisions and orders.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified all 3 subsections, history note, and § 1.1010 severability reference against archived text; confirmed AHC petitions/complaints under § 375.141 with director discretion retained notwithstanding § 621.120.

headings.title: Administrative hearings and judicial review of director orders
headings.reviewNote: Provides chapter 536 hearing and judicial review for aggrieved persons, with de novo review for costs and classification.

headings.title: Judicial review of administrative rules adopted by director
headings.reviewNote: Subjects rules adopted by director to judicial review under provisions of chapter 536.

headings.title: Prohibition on accident response service fees
headings.reviewNote: Bars imposition of accident response service fees on insurers, drivers, vehicle owners, or other persons.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified all 3 subsections and history note against archived text; confirmed chapter 536 hearings/de novo review of costs and violation classification, rule review, and subsection (3) accident response service fee ban (broader than catchline).

headings.title: Office location in Jefferson City, hours, and state facilities
headings.reviewNote: Requires director's office in Jefferson City open weekdays from 8 a.m. to 5 p.m., with furnished capitol facilities.

headings.title: Establishment of branch offices with gubernatorial approval
headings.reviewNote: Permits director to maintain branch offices across Missouri with approval of the governor.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified both subsections and history/prior revision notes against archived text; confirmed Jefferson City office hours/facilities and governor-approved branch offices.

headings.title: Public access to department records and work product exemption
headings.reviewNote: Declares records public while exempting examination and investigation work papers and work product.

headings.title: Furnishing certified copies of filed documents upon fee payment
headings.reviewNote: Requires director to furnish certified copies of filed records to requesting persons upon payment of statutory fees.

headings.title: Five-year retention and disposal of examination and licensing files
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes destruction of routine complaints, working papers, filings, licenses, and hearings after five years.

headings.title: Ten-year retention and disposal of foreign company statements
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes disposal of foreign and alien company annual statements and tax reports after ten years.

headings.title: Compliance with state record disposal and destruction statutes
headings.reviewNote: Mandates that record disposal and destruction comply with sections 109.200 to 109.310.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified all 5 subsections and history/prior revision notes against archived text; confirmed public-record status with work-product exemption, certified copies, 5-year/10-year disposal windows, and §§ 109.200–109.310 compliance.

headings.title: Classification of consumer complaints and investigation records as nonpublic
headings.reviewNote: Classifies section 374.085 consumer complaint files and section 374.190/inquiry/data-call submissions as nonpublic records unavailable under section 374.070.

headings.title: Confidentiality protection and limited subpoena disclosure
headings.reviewNote: Protects nonpublic records from subpoena except by prosecutors or courts, permitting limited interagency sharing.

headings.title: Permitted release of incident reports and examination records
headings.reviewNote: Allows release of initial complaint facts and examination contents when deemed in the public interest.

headings.title: Nonwaiver of privileges and recipient confidentiality obligations
headings.reviewNote: Preserves confidentiality and evidentiary privileges when sharing records with NAIC or law enforcement.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified all 4 subsections and history note against archived text; refined subsection (1) note to match § 374.085 complaint files and § 374.190/data-call submissions, confirmed subpoena limits, incident-report release, and NAIC/regulator nonwaiver.

headings.title: Establishment of mandatory and optional department divisions
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes three or more divisions and mandates Divisions of Consumer Affairs, Insurance Company Regulation, and Insurance Market Regulation.

headings.title: Construction of statutory division of insurance references
headings.reviewNote: Deems statutory and regulatory references to "division of insurance" or "insurance division" to refer to Department of Commerce and Insurance.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified both subsections and history note against archived text; corrected subsection (2) title/note (statutory "division of insurance" references deemed to refer to department) and expanded subsection (1) to include all three mandated divisions.

headings.title: Appointment, powers, oath, and bond of deputy director
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes director to appoint deputy possessing director powers during vacancy or absence, subject to oath and bond.

headings.title: Gubernatorial appointment of acting director from division heads
headings.reviewNote: Directs governor to appoint acting director from division directors if director is absent without appointed deputy.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified both subsections and Effective 6-26-91 note against archived text; confirmed deputy director appointment/powers/bond and gubernatorial acting director appointment.

headings.title: Duties and operational functions of Division of Consumer Affairs
headings.reviewNote: Enumerates division functions including receiving complaints, toll-free hotline, investigations, and consumer brochures.

headings.title: Legal adviser assistance for consumer services division
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes legal adviser assistance by Missouri-licensed attorney knowledgeable in insurance laws.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified both subsections and history note against archived text; confirmed six Division of Consumer Affairs functions (excluding finance/credit unions/professional registration) and legal adviser assistance.

headings.title: Appointment and employment of actuary and chief examiners
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes director to appoint actuary, chief market conduct examiner, and chief financial examiner.

headings.title: Experience qualifications for actuary and chief examiners
headings.reviewNote: Requires at least five years' relevant professional experience for actuary and chief examiners.

headings.title: Prohibition on financial interest in insurance companies
headings.reviewNote: Bars actuary and examiners from holding financial interest in insurance companies other than as policyholders.

headings.title: Surety bond requirement for actuary and examiners
headings.reviewNote: Requires actuary and examiners to post surety bond not exceeding ten thousand dollars.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified all 4 subsections and history/prior revision note against archived text; confirmed actuary and chief examiners appointment, 5-year qualifications, conflict prohibition, and $10,000 bond cap.

headings.title: Professional duties of actuary
headings.reviewNote: Specifies actuary performs duties customary to actuaries and additional duties assigned by director.

headings.title: Remittance and deposit of actuarial fees
headings.reviewNote: Requires fees paid to actuary to be remitted to revenue director and deposited into department fund.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified both subsections and history/prior revision notes against archived text; confirmed actuary duties and remittance of fees to director of revenue for department fund.

headings.title: Chief examiner examination of organizers and insurance entities
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes director through chief examiner to examine insurance organizers/promoters and conduct required examinations of insurance entities.

headings.title: Employment of expert actuaries and assistant examiners
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes director to employ one or more expert actuaries or examiners to assist the chief examiner.

headings.title: Payment of reasonable examination fees by examined entity
headings.reviewNote: Requires examined company, association, organization, or exchange to pay reasonable examination fees and expenses on director-approved accounts.

headings.title: Employment and appointment of clerks and department assistants
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes director to employ clerks and assistants necessary to discharge departmental duties.

headings.title: Appointment, qualifications, and duties of legal counsel
headings.reviewNote: Directs employment of Missouri-licensed legal counsel (AG advises on criminal prosecutions), sets general counsel qualifications/salary cap, and limits hearing officer role.

headings.title: Employment of solvency and market conduct examiners
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes director to employ suitable persons to conduct solvency or market conduct examinations when deemed necessary.

headings.title: Employment and qualifications of reinsurance analyst
headings.reviewNote: Directs employment of reinsurance analyst with accounting degree, three years experience, and Associate in Reinsurance or comparable qualifications.

headings.title: Prohibition on employing insurance company personnel
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits director from employing in any capacity any officer, agent, or employee of any insurance company or association.

headings.title: Payment and deposit of insurance fees into dedicated fund
headings.reviewNote: Directs insurance fees due the state to be paid to director and deposited in state treasury to credit of Insurance Dedicated Fund unless subsection 2 provides otherwise.

headings.title: Insurance Dedicated Fund creation, scope, and lapse limit
headings.reviewNote: Establishes Insurance Dedicated Fund for chapters 325, 354, 374–385 fees, credits interest earnings, and bars general revenue lapse except above 2x annual appropriations/receipts.

headings.title: Payment of department expenses and limitation on state liability
headings.reviewNote: Directs payment of department expenses out of fees and funds, providing state bears no liability for expenses.

headings.title: Reimbursement of fund for state services to troubled insurers
headings.reviewNote: Requires domestic companies under conservation or liquidation to reimburse fund for state employee services.

headings.title: Payment of director salaries and general operational expenses
headings.reviewNote: Requires director and deputy salaries and unpaid expenses to be paid from state treasury as provided by law.

headings.title: Assessment of examination expenses into Insurance Examiners Fund
headings.reviewNote: Requires assessment of examination costs against examined entities and payment from Insurance Examiners Fund.

headings.title: Double liability and collection costs for nonpayment of assessments
headings.reviewNote: Imposes double liability and collection costs on companies refusing to pay assessed examination costs.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified all 5 subsections and 1962 State ex rel. Johnson v. Leggett annotation against archived text; confirmed company expense liability, conservation/liquidation reimbursement, general expenses, examiners fund assessment, and double-liability collection.

headings.title: Establishment and initial assessment for Insurance Examiners Fund
headings.reviewNote: Establishes Insurance Examiners Fund and mandates initial 1991 proportionate industry assessment of $400,000.

headings.title: Supplemental assessment authority for minimum fund balance
headings.reviewNote: Permits supplemental 1993-1994 assessment up to $400,000 with minimum $250 and maximum $2,000 caps.

headings.reviewNote: Specifies biennial report contents including financial accounting, company capital, and deposited collateral.

headings.reviewNote: Caps publication of printed biennial reports at two thousand copies at department expense.

headings.title: Submission of additional reports required by governor
headings.reviewNote: Requires director to make additional reports as requested by the governor.

headings.title: Promulgation of uniform health care provider claim forms
headings.reviewNote: Directs director to prescribe uniform health claim reporting forms after consultation and public hearing.

headings.reviewNote: Clarifies insurers may request additional claim data and exempts electronic claims and agreed contract forms.

headings.reviewNote: Requires chapter 536 rulemaking with effective date at least 180 days after adoption barring nonconforming forms.

headings.reviewNote: Authorizes coordination and consultation with NAIC, state and federal financial regulators, and law enforcement.

headings.reviewNote: Outlines policies to maximize consumer protection, foster regulatory uniformity, and minimize industry burdens.

headings.reviewNote: Lists cooperative actions including electronic depositories, uniform forms, joint examinations, and training.

headings.title: Director duty to investigate insurance violations and business
headings.reviewNote: Requires director to investigate violations of insurance laws and examine insurance business in Missouri.

headings.title: Examination of witnesses under oath and production of records
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes director to examine company officers under oath, summon witnesses, and compel document production.

headings.title: Appointment of special investigators and evidence of authority
headings.reviewNote: Permits appointing investigators with equal powers under official seal and employing necessary clerical, actuarial, and other assistance.

headings.reviewNote: Applies section 374.205 confidentiality protections to market conduct working papers, reports, and records.

headings.reviewNote: Applies section 32.065 annual adjusted prime rate (capped at 9% per annum) to ordered or voluntary interest on claims, refunds, or penalties lacking a statutory rate.

headings.reviewNote: Exempts payments under section 376.383 and other statutes with specific interest rates from section.

headings.title: Purpose and flexibility of comprehensive examination system
headings.reviewNote: Declares purpose to establish effective examination framework enabling flexible allocation of resources.

headings.title: Definitions of terms used in examination provisions
headings.reviewNote: Defines company, department, director, examiner, insurer, and person for examination provisions.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified both subsections and history note against archived text; confirmed flexible examination system purpose and 6 definitions for sections 374.202 to 374.207.

headings.title: Discretionary and mandatory five-year examination scheduling
headings.reviewNote: Mandates financial exam at least every five years, allows related-party reviews, and governs foreign exam reports.

headings.title: Examination warrants, document access, and retention requirements
headings.reviewNote: Directs warrant issuance, ten-day record compliance, policy and claim retention periods, and subpoena powers.

headings.title: Examination report filing, rebuttal, adoption, and hearings
headings.reviewNote: Governs 60-day verified report filing, 30-day rebuttal, director adoption/rejection/investigatory hearing orders, director or counsel affidavits, and 10-day post-adoption confidentiality.

headings.title: Confidentiality of working papers and NAIC access
headings.reviewNote: Protects examination working papers and documents as confidential and exempt from subpoena, permitting NAIC access under written confidentiality agreement.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified all 4 subsections and history note against archived text; corrected swapped subsections (3) and (4) titles/notes to match 60-day verified report/rebuttal/hearing/adoption procedures and working-paper confidentiality with NAIC access.

headings.title: Examiner conflict-of-interest restrictions and exceptions
headings.reviewNote: Bars appointing examiners with conflicts of interest, with four safe-harbor exceptions (policyholder, customary mortgage, diversified funds, blind trust) and independent specialist proviso.

headings.title: Payment of examination expenses under section 374.160
headings.reviewNote: Directs examination expenses and costs to be paid as set forth in section 374.160.

headings.title: Common-law official immunity for director and examiners
headings.reviewNote: Grants director, authorized representatives, and appointed examiners common-law official immunity.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified all 3 subsections and history note against archived text; replaced all 3 swapped draft titles/notes to match examiner conflict-of-interest rules/exceptions, § 374.160 expense payment, and common-law official immunity.

headings.title: Prohibition on false sworn statements and false records
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits knowingly making false sworn statements or records submitted to director and making false entries or certificates in company books or filings ("andchapters" verbatim).

headings.title: Judicial enforcement of subpoenas, contempt sanctions, and penalties
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes court applications to enforce subpoenas, impose contempt, injunctive relief, and civil penalties.

headings.title: Right to petition circuit court for relief from subpoena
headings.reviewNote: Clarifies that recipients may petition circuit court for protective relief from department subpoenas.

headings.title: Privilege against self-incrimination and compelled testimony immunity
headings.reviewNote: Compels testimony over self-incrimination assertions under court order with criminal immunity except perjury.

headings.title: Administrative enforcement orders and level four classification
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes administrative orders under section 374.046 and classifies violations as level four.

headings.title: Civil court actions for violations of this section
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes civil court actions under section 374.048 for violations of this section, with subsection 1 violations classified as level four.

headings.title: Criminal felony penalty and license revocation for knowing violations
headings.reviewNote: Classifies knowing violations as class E felonies and mandates license revocation upon sentencing.

headings.title: Referral of criminal violations to prosecutors or attorney general
headings.reviewNote: Permits director to refer evidence of violations to prosecuting attorneys or attorney general.

headings.title: Reservation of state authority to prosecute other crimes
headings.reviewNote: Preserves state authority to prosecute criminal conduct under other state statutes.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified all 9 subsections and Effective 1-01-17 note against archived text; corrected subsections (1) and (6) titles/notes for false statements/records ("andchapters" verbatim) and civil actions, and confirmed contempt, self-incrimination immunity, and class E felony.

headings.title: Notice of delinquent statutory report and fifteen-day cure period
headings.reviewNote: Requires first-class mail notice of delinquent reports, granting fifteen-day cure period before daily violations accrue.

headings.title: Administrative orders and level two classification for filing failure
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes administrative enforcement under section 374.046, classifying violations as level two with license suspension.

headings.title: Civil court enforcement actions for report filing violations
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes civil court actions under section 374.048 for report filing violations, classified as level two.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified all 3 subsections and history note against archived text; confirmed 15-day cure notice for delinquent reports and level two administrative and civil court enforcement.

headings.title: Criminal offense of filing false insurance statement
headings.reviewNote: Defines crime of filing financial statements intended to misrepresent company financial condition.

headings.title: Class D felony classification for false statement offense
headings.reviewNote: Classifies offense of filing false insurance statement as class D felony.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified both subsections and Effective 1-01-17 note against archived text; confirmed offense of filing false insurance financial statement and class D felony classification.

headings.title: Prohibition on covenants not to sue regulated entities or officers
headings.reviewNote: Bars department employees from entering into covenants not to sue or forbearance agreements with regulated entities or officers.

headings.title: Violation of public policy and judicial unenforceability of covenants
headings.reviewNote: Declares covenants not to sue contrary to public policy and unenforceable in Missouri courts.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified both subsections and history note against archived text; confirmed ban on covenants not to sue regulated entities or officers and public-policy judicial unenforceability.

headings.title: Assessment of examination and proceeding expenses against companies
headings.reviewNote: Requires director to assess costs of proceedings, examinations, and policy valuations against subject companies.

headings.title: Department payment upon insolvency and first lien on assets
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes department payment of expenses if company insolvent, establishing first lien on company assets.

headings.title: Approval of cost vouchers by commissioner of administration
headings.reviewNote: Requires submission and approval of examination cost vouchers by commissioner of administration before payment.

headings.title: Certification of departmental examination costs for collection
headings.reviewNote: Requires examination costs incurred by salaried employees to be certified to revenue director for collection.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified all 4 subsections and 1956–1962 case annotations (Barker, Jensen, Leggett, Johnson) against archived text; confirmed expense assessment, insolvency first lien, voucher approval, and salaried-employee cost certification.

headings.title: Authority of director to bring suit for fee collection
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes director to bring legal action to recover statutory fees and charges.

headings.title: Double liability and costs for failure to pay fees upon demand
headings.reviewNote: Imposes double liability and costs if fees or assessments remain unpaid ten days after written demand.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified both subsections and history/prior revision notes against archived text; confirmed director suit authority and double liability with costs after 10 days written demand.

headings.title: Requirement of payment vouchers and revenue department receipts
headings.reviewNote: Mandates director obtain payment vouchers and revenue receipts for all department disbursements and remittances.

headings.title: Annual state auditor review of department dedicated funds
headings.reviewNote: Requires state auditor to audit receipts and disbursements in dedicated fund and examiners fund annually.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified both subsections and history/prior revision notes against archived text; confirmed payment vouchers/revenue receipts and annual state auditor audit of dedicated and examiners funds.

headings.title: Election of workers' compensation coverage for department personnel
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes department election to provide workers' compensation coverage to all employees under chapter 287.

headings.title: Funding methods through insurance or benefit fund deposit
headings.reviewNote: Allows coverage through commercial insurance purchase or administrative fund deposit from general appropriations.

headings.title: Rulemaking authority classifying eligible department employees
headings.reviewNote: Directs department to promulgate rules classifying employee eligibility for workers' compensation coverage.

headings.title: Authority of director to implement workers' compensation coverage
headings.reviewNote: Empowers director to execute necessary duties to carry out workers' compensation coverage.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified all 4 subsections and history note against archived text; confirmed workers' compensation election/self-insurance, general-appropriation funding, decisive employee classification rules, and director implementation authority.

headings.title: Administrative penalty orders, civil recovery, and license sanctions
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes director penalty orders under section 374.049, civil actions after ten days, and license sanctions.

headings.title: Voluntary forfeiture agreements and remittance to school fund
headings.reviewNote: Permits voluntary forfeiture settlements without civil action, directing proceeds to public school fund.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified both subsections and 1982 Shqeir v. Equifax, Inc. annotation against archived text; confirmed § 374.049 penalty orders, 10-day civil recovery, willful license sanctions, and voluntary forfeitures to school fund.

headings.title: Establishment of statistical bases for residential insurance reporting
headings.reviewNote: Directs director to establish statistical reporting bases for homeowners, dwelling, renters, and residential fire policies.

headings.title: Annual insurer reporting of residential premium and loss data
headings.reviewNote: Mandates annual reporting by insurers of residential insurance premium and loss data required by director.

headings.title: Director authority to review and verify reported statistical data
headings.reviewNote: Empowers director to review and verify the accuracy of reported residential property insurance data.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified all 3 subsections and history note against archived text; confirmed residential insurance statistical bases, annual insurer premium/loss reporting, and director verification.

headings.title: Definition of product liability insurance policies
headings.reviewNote: Defines product liability insurance policies for statistical reporting provisions under sections 374.400 to 374.425.

headings.title: Annual product liability reporting upon department request
headings.reviewNote: Requires insurers to file product liability reports within sixty days of January 1 if requested by department.

headings.title: Reporting of product liability claims, judgments, and settlements
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes director to require reporting of claims resulting in final judgments, settlements, or dispositions without payment.

headings.title: Detailed reporting criteria for product liability claim data
headings.reviewNote: Enumerates claim data items including location, product type, rating code, occurrence date, and settlement amounts.

headings.title: Reporting of claim reserve amounts and reserve timing
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes director to require reporting of claim reserve totals, setting years, and annual reserve allocations.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified all 5 subsections and Effective 6-26-91 note against archived text; confirmed product liability policy definition, on-request annual report (13 items), claim/judgment reporting (17 criteria), and reserve timing.

headings.title: Health care quality and patient satisfaction reporting requirement
headings.reviewNote: Requires health care financing entities to submit quality and satisfaction data, deeming failure an unfair trade practice.

headings.title: Data standards consultation and HEDIS initial data set
headings.reviewNote: Directs director to use HEDIS initial dataset and consult national accreditation bodies and billing committee.

headings.title: Prohibition on pain control scoring requirements
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits director from requiring patient scoring of pain control within data standards.

headings.title: Discontinuation of patient satisfaction scores after August 28, 2018
headings.reviewNote: Directs director to discontinue use and public disclosure of patient satisfaction scores beginning August 28, 2018.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified all 4 subsections and dual effective dates (7-06-18 S.B. 718; 8-28-18 S.B. 951) against archived text; confirmed quality/satisfaction data reporting, HEDIS/consultation standards, pain-scoring ban, and post-Aug 28, 2018 satisfaction-score discontinuation.

headings.title: Establishment of statistical bases for automobile insurance
headings.reviewNote: Directs director to establish statistical bases for premium and loss data reporting for automobile insurance.

headings.title: Annual insurer reporting of automobile premium and loss data
headings.reviewNote: Requires insurers to report automobile premium and loss data annually to director or designated statistical agency.

headings.title: Authority of director to review and verify reported auto data
headings.reviewNote: Grants director authority to review and verify the accuracy of reported automobile insurance data.

headings.title: Public dissemination of automobile insurance statistical reports
headings.reviewNote: Mandates director compile acquired automobile data into public reports available to the general public.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified all 4 subsections and Effective 7-01-80 note against archived text; confirmed automobile insurance statistical bases, annual reporting, director verification, and public reports.

headings.title: Certificate requirement for utilization review agents
headings.reviewNote: Requires utilization review agents to obtain department certificate before conducting reviews in Missouri.

headings.title: Exemption for internal facility utilization review programs
headings.reviewNote: Exempts general in-house facility utilization reviews that do not decide payment approval or denial for specific cases.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified both subsections and Effective 7-10-91 note against archived text; confirmed utilization review agent certificate requirement and in-house facility exemption.

headings.title: Application submission and fee payment for review certificate
headings.reviewNote: Requires applicants to submit certification application and pay regulatory fee established by department.

headings.title: Form, supporting documentation, and verification of application
headings.reviewNote: Mandates application be on department form, signed and verified, and accompanied by supporting documents.

headings.title: Application fee calculation for program administrative costs
headings.reviewNote: Requires application fee be sufficient to fund administrative and program costs under sections 374.500 to 374.515.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified all 3 subsections and Effective 7-10-91 note against archived text; confirmed certificate application/fee submission, verified form/documentation, and program-cost fee calculation.

headings.title: Mandatory compliance with statutory utilization review standards
headings.reviewNote: Requires all utilization review agents to meet standards set forth in sections 376.1350 to 376.1390.

headings.title: January 1, 1998 compliance deadline for existing certificates
headings.reviewNote: Requires agents certified before September 1, 1997 to meet standards by January 1, 1998 or face invalidation.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified both subsections and history note against archived text; confirmed §§ 376.1350–376.1390 minimum standards and January 1, 1998 compliance deadline for pre-September 1, 1997 certificates.

headings.title: Notice of suspected violation and thirty-day response window
headings.reviewNote: Directs director to notify utilization review agents of alleged violations, granting thirty days to respond.

headings.title: Administrative enforcement orders and level two classification
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes administrative orders under section 374.046 and classifies violations as level two with license suspension.

headings.title: Civil court enforcement actions for review agent violations
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes civil actions under section 374.048 and classifies violations as level two under section 374.049.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified all 3 subsections and history note against archived text; confirmed 30-day response notice and level two administrative and civil court enforcement for utilization review agent violations.

headings.title: Submission of major department contracts to Attorney General
headings.reviewNote: Requires forwarding written contracts or intent letters exceeding $100,000 to Attorney General prior to execution.

headings.title: Attorney General review timeframe, approval, and amendments
headings.reviewNote: Mandates Attorney General review within 10 days (30 days for $1M+ contracts) for legal form and content, with deemed approval upon nonresponse.

headings.title: Attorney-client privilege and public record status of disposition
headings.reviewNote: Protects review communications as attorney-client privileged while subjecting written disposition to chapter 610.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified all 3 subsections and history note against archived text; confirmed mandatory Attorney General submission above $100,000, 10-day/30-day ($1M+) review and deemed approval, and attorney-client privilege with chapter 610 disposition.
